_metadata.description: Advanced video output profiles. First-release contract; completion follows requirement-linked behavior and retained protocol evidence.

requirements.title: The exporter may qualify advanced output profiles.
requirements.description: Where optional 4K, higher-frame-rate or HDR output is added, the exporter may expose it only with separately qualified source adequacy, color/codec, resource and visual evidence.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-OUTPUT-ADVANCED protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.
